jobs.prompt:
Build Reading Nook in one self-contained index.html: a reading log for children aged 7 to 10. A child can add books (title, author, total pages), log pages read each day, see a weekly summary of pages read as a simple bar chart, set a weekly page goal and see progress, and finished books move to a 'My Shelf' section with a small celebration message.

The previous attempt failed two saved project decisions. Fix both explicitly:
1. Palette: use a warm palette only — orange #e8862e, gold #e8a838 and peach #f6c9a0 — on a cream #fdf6ec background. Do not use green anywhere: no green header, buttons, bars, borders, tags or backgrounds.
2. Storage: save all app data in window.localStorage and load it on startup, so books, the pages logged each day, the weekly goal and the finished-books shelf survive a page reload. This project decision overrides any generic instruction against browser storage. Make no network requests and use no external scripts, fonts or images.

Also: no countdown timers or time pressure; no flashing or blinking; every status (goal met, in progress, finished) must have a text label or icon, never colour alone; tap targets at least 44px; plain, encouraging words; no scores or rankings that compare children. Count only pages actually read (cap at the pages left), and key daily totals by real dates so a new week starts clean.
